name: JEH Solar LLC
old_description: Lafayette, LA's premier solar power and electrical contractors with 30 Years of Experience. Serving all of Louisiana and parts of Texas.
about:
JEH Solar LLC was founded in 1996 in Lafayette, Louisiana. The company is locally owned and operated in South Louisiana, providing solar power and electrical contracting services across the region and into parts of Texas.

The firm designs, installs, and services solar power systems, electrical systems, and backup generators for both residential and commercial customers. Its capabilities include solar system engineering, panel and power system installation, electrical panel work, lighting installation and repair, off-grid solar and generator installation, and end-to-end project management with on-site job supervision. Crews serve the Lafayette and Baton Rouge areas.

Customers range from homeowners seeking rooftop solar and backup power to businesses needing commercial electrical services and solar installations. The company has worked on residential rooftops and commercial facilities throughout South Louisiana.

JEH Solar emphasizes its NABCEP-certified electricians and installers, noting that its team travels nationally to teach other companies solar installation and maintenance practices. The company positions itself as a full-service contractor that handles design, permitting, installation, and commissioning in-house, aiming to complete projects correctly the first time.
